silhouette.reason: Gable hall, two coursed drum towers with conical red caps and finials, a porch and two banners: reads as a stylised RTS barracks from every sheet view. The porch roof is a thin slab that reads as a tilted plank in the hero, and the gate under it barely shows, so the front loses its focal entrance.
fixes: give the porch a real pitched roof (two slopes + ridge) and deepen the gate recess in roof.ts porch()/gate() so the entrance reads in black

proportions.reason: 15.9 x 18.5 x 11.1 m, gate 3.5 m beside 1.8 m units; storey and door scale per the house playbook. Towers are tall versus the hall and the windows are narrow amber slits, which reads stylised but slightly toy-like.
fixes: widen the window openings to ~0.8 m with a stone sill and head (walls.ts) so the bay rhythm matches a real hall

materials.reason: Dressed-stone blocks read as stone, lime-plaster gables in an oak frame read, red team slate reads more like painted sheet metal panels (uniform value, no slate edge variation). In sheet.png the oak porch posts render pale grey-white, not brown.
fixes: per-slate value jitter and overlapping thickness on roofSlopes() so the roof reads as slate, not sheet panels
check the oak role on porch posts/timber: they read pale grey in sheet.png while brown in hero.png

detail.reason: Running-bond blocks, pilasters, timber gable frame, oculus, finials and banners exist; at hero distance the walls are flat between pilasters, windows have no frames or sills, and the towers have no openings or arrow slits.
fixes: arrow slits and a door on each tower (roof.ts tower())
a bracketed porch lamp and steps with nosings at the gate

wear.reason: weather() is applied, but at hero distance the stone and plaster read clean; no visible moss at the wall foot, no streaks below windows, roof uniform red.
fixes: raise weather() streak and damp coverage under eaves and sills so it shows at 3/4 hero distance
fade and dust the roof slates toward the ridge, darken the drip line along the eaves

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps hall, towers, roof and banners in the same colour blocks; the stone coursing collapses to flat beige boxes per bay and the towers become coarse octagons, so the stone read is lost at distance.
fixes: bake the block coursing as value stripes in vertex colour at LOD2 (walls.ts stack())
